It's shaped like the mark of the Yatagarasu, and is
very eyecatching indeed.

I can't imagine any thief other than Kay would
want to wear it...

There's something I've been wondering for a while
now, but...
...is this pin something you inherited or...?
Nope!{E108:0020} There wasn't one, so I made it myself!
I suppose that makes sense.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}It is quite flashy.
I can't imagine any other thief wanting to wear it.
Whaaat!?{E108:0020} You don't have to be so mean, you know!
Can you show me the inside of your pin again, Kay?
Sure!

But you don't have to ask me to do it.{E108:0010}
You can just do it yourself...
Oh, wait!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}Is it too tricky for you?{E108:0010} Is that it?
Just hurry up and open it, will you?
Yessir!
This is where the bug was hidden.

Can't believe I let somebody slip that on me.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I'll NEVER live that down!{E108:0008} Ever!
(There's no need to get quite so upset...)
Huh?{E108:0020} Whoa!
Heh.{E108:0010} So I was right.
This is the pin Kay always wears.

It's shaped like the mark of the Yatagarasu, and is
very eyecatching indeed.

I can't imagine any thief other than Kay would
want to wear it...
The listening device was hidden inside it.

There's nothing in there anymore, but
perhaps we should check it just in case.

Let's open it up, shall we?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}(We can only hope there's something of value inside...)
Could this be...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}the bell that was on Mr. Kanis's chisel?

Perhaps there's some trace evidence that can
prove that one way or the other.
...It's no good.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Look at it.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}It's spotless.

Mr. Kanis's bell.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}As we've established, it doesn't
have a whole lot to tell us.
Never mind the bell!{E108:0018} Look at the paper it's wrapped in!
Very well...
!{E108:0020} And look --{E108:0008} it's covered in {E1D1}some sort of oil!
Let's look over the sides of the basket just in case.
Alright!{E108:0010} I'll start from over here!

Hey!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}What are you doing just standing there!?{E108:0010}
Help them too, will you?
Yes, Shifu!
This side's clean!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Not even a speck of dirt!

(Hmm...{E108:0010} But I'm right about this, I know I am.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}I need to think about the sound it made when it hit.)

(It sounded like something harder than the wicker
part of the basket.{E108:0010} Like metal, in fact...)
I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}was carried in this basket, right?

Yes.{E108:0010} Although you were asleep, so I imagine you
have no memory of it.

Ugh...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Would've been nice to have at least gotten
some fun flying memories out of it...

Curse you, Mr. Mastermind!{E108:0018}
I'm gonna kick your butt, just you wait and see!

But...{E108:0008} that's not the main reason you want to 
get your revenge...{E108:0008} is it...?
A hole!
With a bullet stuck in it!

The sound we heard on that tape must have been
the president firing a gun.

And this must be all that remains of the bullet he fired.{E108:0010}
There's no denying it now.

You'll find the truth behind all this,{E108:0018} won't you,
Mr. Edgeworth!?

I had to get kidnapped so we could get our
hands on this piece of evidence!

(I wouldn't exactly say that's how we got our hands
on it, Ms. Great Thief.)

But, of course, Kay.{E108:0010} You can count on me.{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}I'll bring your kidnapper to justice!

There's a {E107:0003}suuuper long {E107:0002}rope curled up in the
bottom of the basket here.

Look it over --{E108:0008} are there signs of it having been
struck by a bullet?

On it!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}Hey, Mr. Black-Suit --{E108:0008} take the other end,
will you?

Nothing here, either.{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Huh...{E108:0010} Guess this isn't what it hit...
Then let's move on and find out what it did...

When we've finally proven who was behind all this,
let's tie them up with this rope!

I'll teach you a way of doing it so that even a
professional escapologist couldn't get free!

I understand the sentiment, but perhaps you could
apply that fervor to the pursuit of the truth instead?

There's a gas tank here.{E108:0010} It's fixed to the side
of the basket.
Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Doesn't look like it's been hit by {E108:0018}{E107:0003}{E1D1}any bullets.

Which is lucky --{E108:0008} that would not have ended
well for anybody nearby.
Alright, let's look elsewhere, shall we?
Don't worry!{E108:0020} I've got my eyes on that tank!

Simeon {E108:000C}{E107:0001}{E1D1}won't be escaping in his balloon
if I have anything to do with it!

I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}struggle to imagine him choosing to make
his getaway by balloon...

Look, you just leave this to me!{E108:0018} Go and concentrate
on nailing him for his crimes, alright!?

The combination lock on the gate leading to the
plaza was intact when Ms. Nichols arrived.

But the lock on the gate leading out to the side
of the Bigg Building had been cut.
What does this tell us?
Hee hee!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}Easy!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}That the killer used the side gate!
Precisely.{E108:0018} {E12F:00000004}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}And it tells us something else important, too.

Namely that our culprit didn't know the number
for the combination lock.

You're right!{E108:0018} It would have been way easier to
come in that way if they did!

But instead, they chose the classic thief's route:{E108:0008}
the lesser-known side entrance.

This is no run-of-the-mill criminal, {E108:0008}{E107:0001}{E1D1}Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018}
{E280}We need to keep our wits about us!
(I'm not sure we should be excited by that fact, {E108:0008}{E107:0003}Kay...)

Anyway, we know that everybody working on the
movie knew the combination.

Which makes it likely that our culprit wasn't a
member of the cast or crew.

Movie Set Locks data jotted down
in my Organizer.
Both the dent in the fence {E108:0018}and the broken horn...
...weren't there yesterday, according to our witness.
Which leads me to wonder...

Wait --{E108:0018} you think that giant Taurusaurus
head could've...
There's no sign of a murder weapon anywhere.
Oh yeah!{E108:0018} There isn't!
Now, this is still only a possibility...

...but if the Taurusaurus head somehow fell
from the roof up there...
Yeah!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}That could kill somebody for sure!

Ms. Nichols --{E108:0010} would you mind if we took a look
up on the roof of the trailer?
You wanna go up there?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Sure, I don't see why not!

Knock yourselves out!{E108:0018} ...Oh, but don't do that
literally --{E108:0008} the steps can be kinda slippy!

So we've learned a little something about
the kidnappers.
Ms. Lloyd saw two men taking Shaun away.

And the taxi driver remembers giving two
similar-looking men a ride.
They must be the same people, right?

I'd say it's a distinct possibility, yes.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}But there's one thing that doesn't make sense.
Could it be the kidnappers who stole the case?
Yes.{E108:0010} What if they put Shaun inside it?
He's little enough that he'd fit, I guess.
So the reason the taxi driver didn't see him...

...Might be that he was loaded into the trunk
as "baggage".
But why did they need to hide him?
I imagine they might not have planned to originally.

But they didn't count on there being a police
presence here in the plaza.

Right.{E108:0010} That makes sense!{E108:0018} {E107:0003}They didn't want the 
officer on duty to see them going off with Shaun...
...So they took a rather drastic measure.
That must be it!
Alright!{E108:0010} Let's go see what the taxi driver can tell us!

The two men you told us about --{E108:0008} did they have
any baggage with them?

Boy, did they!{E108:0010} A giant case!{E108:0010} Wasn't easy
getting that thing in the trunk, I tell ya!

That settles it!{E108:0018} They MUST have been
the kidnappers!

Where did you take these two men, if you don't
mind me asking?
Look, I can see this is important.
How about I give you a ride there?
That's a great idea!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Come on, Mr. Edgeworth!
Alright.{E108:0010} Thank you.
Heh!{E108:0010} My pleasure, folks!
Mr. Saint.{E108:0010} You mentioned {E041}fireworks{E040} before.
Huh?{E108:0020} Fireworks?

Yes.{E108:0010} At the event at the coliseum.{E108:0010} Were they
setting them off even during daylight hours?
Oh, yeah!{E108:0018} A bunch went off while we were there!
What are you thinking, Mr. Edgeworth?
The loud {E041}bang{E040} we heard...
What if that was a firework?
Huh!
Don't think for one second you'll get away with this!

Oh, don't worry.{E108:0018} {E1D1}I'm counting on you at least trying
to track me down!{E108:0010} That'll be half the fun!

Heh...{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}Not that I rate your chances of bringing
me to justice particularly highly.
BANG!

For the bang to be clearly audible over the 
telephone, it must have been pretty loud.

Yes.{E108:0010} The area we'd need to search would be too
broad to even consider doing it ourselves.
(But if the police were to lend a hand...)

Only two vehicles came through here this morning:{E108:0008}
The taxi and a blue truck.
And Eustace was {E1D1}taken away in the taxi.

Right.{E108:0010} While it seems that Shaun was likely
abducted from the garbage disposal area.
And if the garbage was collected at 11 AM...

...{E108:0018}{E12F:00010007}{E280}{E107:0001}Oh!{E108:0020} I get it!{E108:0018} Now we know what kind of truck
it was!
Indeed.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}It must have been {E108:000C}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}the garbage truck.

But the police officer who told us about it didn't
describe it as such.
He only mentioned the fact that {E108:0008}{E1D1}it was blue.

Heh!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}Some cop he was!{E108:0010} How did he not even notice
it was one of those cool trash-squishing machines!?

Because it wasn't.{E108:0010} Today isn't a regular garbage
day.{E108:0010} It's the day they collect larger items.

For which they wouldn't use a specialized garbage
truck.{E108:0010} {E1D5}Just a regular truck like any other.
...But it was a garbage truck nonetheless.
And where do garbage trucks go?
Wait a second!

So you're saying the kidnapper disguised
themselves as a trash collector?

But then, the truck would probably have been fake,
too, right?{E108:0010} {E1D1}So maybe it didn't go to the dump.
...No.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'm reasonably sure the garbage truck was real.
Yeah?{E108:0020} {E1D1}How do you figure that?

Another look at the garbage disposal area
should tell us.

What tells us that the garbage truck must have
been real?

Wait, wait, wait --{E108:0018} you're saying there's something
important there?
Yes.{E108:0010} Proof that the garbage truck was real.
You don't agree?
Nope!

Gah!{E108:0018}
(Did I get it wrong?)

(If the truck wasn't real, the driver wouldn't have
been able to collect the garbage.)
(Wasn't there something here that proved that...?)

I don't get it, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018} How do you know
the garbage truck was real!?
The garbage disposal area is kept locked.

Oh, yeah!{E108:0020} {E1D1}So only a real garbage collector in a real
garbage truck could have opened it!

Precisely.{E108:0010} The garbage truck can't have been
a fake.

Perhaps whoever abducted Shaun put him in a large
cardboard box that they'd prepared for the job.

Now, mix that in amongst all the other oversized
items...

And the garbage collector would've taken it away, no
questions asked!

Exactly.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Allowing the kidnapper to await the truck's
arrival at the garbage processing facility.

They could then claim to have thrown the box away
by mistake,{E108:0008} and collect it without incident.

Alright,{E108:0018} so where do they take the garbage after
it leaves here?
Let's see...{E108:0020} {E107:0002}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}Looks like we have two possibilities.

So, based on the loud bang we heard on
the phone call...

...we know that the kidnapper was somewhere 
in the vicinity of Sunshine Coliseum.
And one of the garbage facilities is right by there, too!
I think it's likely that's where Shaun was taken.

Which means...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}the kidnapper must be holding him
somewhere near there.
Detective Gumshoe.
Yessir!

Could I ask you and your men to search the area
around the garbage facility?

...It's not like you to ask, sir.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Feels a little...{E108:000C} {E107:0002}flat, if I'm
being totally honest.

...Why don't you gimme a good, old-fashioned
order, huh?{E108:0010} Like you used to?

You don't mind?{E108:0020} Even though I'm not a
prosecutor anymore?
I thought I told you already!

A detective investigates for himself,{E108:0008} not just for
prosecutors!
...Thank you.

So that's what our monstrous "hoof prints"
really were...
Wait, what?

Recall the arrangement of the prints.{E108:0010}
Now compare it to that of the planters.
Whoa!

That's right.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E283}I believe the footprints are located
exactly where our planters once stood.

So Chairman Winner was...{E108:000C} {E107:0003}digging around the 
front of them?
He was.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:0000000B}And why might he have been doing that?

We have a piece of evidence in our possession 
that answers exactly that question.

Which piece of evidence shows why Chairman Winner
might have been digging in front of the planters?{E040}{E106}{E163:00010000}{E100:0001}{E164:00D50003}{E100:0000}{E12F:00000009}{E101:00000000}{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}THIS tells us why he was digging those holes!

Ooh, interesting!{E108:0010} Well?{E108:0018}
Are you going to explain?
No siree!{E108:0010} I don't see it at all!
As one might expect --{E108:0018} {E12F:00000004}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}because I don't see it either!
Ugh!{E108:0018} Can you PLEASE take this seriously?

...Fine.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}(That wasn't the piece of evidence we needed.)

Look over everything again!{E108:0018} Maybe there's
something written down somewhere!

I will.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}There's something here that tells us what
the ex-chairman was up to, I'm sure of it.

Recall, if you will, the report that Warden Laguarde
sent to Chairman Winner.

In it, she mentioned something that had been{E108:000C}
{E107:0003}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}"laid to rest" {E041}in front of a planter{E040}.
You think she was telling him where to dig?
Wait --{E108:0008} {E284}but why three holes?

Because the report didn't specify which of the planters
she meant.
I get it.{E108:0018} So he wasn't sure which one it was.
Which meant he had to try and dig up all three.
I imagine so, yes.{E108:0018} Poor Chairman Winner.

But why go to all that trouble?{E108:0010} {E043}What was he
looking for{E040}?

It seems quite likely that the {E043}missing brick{E040} was the
one used in the murder, wouldn't you say?{E106}{E198:00040016}{E100:0001}{E1AE}{E111:000200000003000100010002}{E122:000000010002}{E112:0002}{E112:0000}{E100:0000}{E101:00020002}{E107:0002}{E285}Oh, yeah!{E108:0018} Now that you mention it, they're the
exact same shape and size!

I think we have to conclude that the murder
actually happened over by the snowman.

Right.{E108:0010} The button came from there, {E108:000C}and the
brick, too.

Indeed.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00000008}And what's more, if the murderer took the
brick from right by the snowman...

...and then tried to sneak up on the victim all the 
way over by the planters...
Mr. Aldown would have seen them right away!
Exactly.
I think we need to update the simulation, {E108:0010}Kay.

Mr. Aldown wasn't standing by the planters.{E108:0010}
He was next to the snowman.
Gotcha!{E108:0018} Alright, here goes...

If Chairman Winner was involved in
President Wang's abduction...

...then it seems likely that whatever he dug up
yesterday had something to do with the kidnapping.
Oh, I get it!
Y-You do?
You bet I do!{E108:0018} {E1D1}We're talking treasure, right?{E108:000C} Loot!
He must have been {E108:000C}{E285}digging up the {E041}ransom money{E040}!

The {E041}ransom money{E040}?{E108:0010} One hundred million dollars
is an awful lot of cash...

Burying it would have been a good way to keep it
hidden until the heat died down.
It certainly seems like a possibility.
Hee hee!{E108:0010} Glad you agree!
