{E107:0001}{E1D2}mysteries of past and present once and for all!
entries.ru:
Погляжу с удовольствием.{E108:0018}{E152:0007000C000D}{E112:0007} Пора раз и навсегда{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D2}закрыть загадки прошлого и настоящего!

entries.en:
Please, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} {E1D5}{E12F:0008000B}{E112:0008}{E12F:0008000C}{E1D2}{E1D5}{E188:00200000}Deal the final blow to this
unforgivably wicked man!
entries.ru:
Прошу вас, мистер Эджворт.{E108:0010} {E1D5}{E12F:0008000B}{E112:0008}{E12F:0008000C}{E1D2}{E1D5}{E188:00200000}Нанесите последний удар
этому злодею, которому нет прощения!

entries.en:
This last piece of evidence will prove your guilt 
beyond a doubt!
entries.ru:
Эта последняя улика докажет вашу вину
без всяких сомнений!

entries.en:
(What should we expect to find on the balloon
if it was used to crush the president?){E106}{E163:00010000}{E100:0001}{E164:00E00008}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}This is it, Mr. Saint!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}This right here proves--
entries.ru:
(Что должно остаться на шаре, если им
раздавили президента?){E106}{E163:00010000}{E100:0001}{E164:00E00008}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}Вот оно, мистер Святов!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}Вот это и доказывает--

entries.en:
EEEHEEHEEHEEEE!{E108:0020} {E107:0003}{E20F}Ah, Miles!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}You fell at the final hurdle!
entries.ru:
И-ХИ-ХИ-ХИ-ХИ-ХИ!{E108:0020} {E107:0003}{E20F}Ах, Майлз!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}Споткнулись на последнем шагу!

entries.en:
Did you really think THAT was how you were going
to nail me!?
entries.ru:
Вы правда думали, что прижмёте меня
ВОТ ЭТИМ!?

entries.en:
What part of it would even have stuck to the balloon?{E108:0018}
That doesn't make sense!
entries.ru:
Да что от этого вообще осталось бы на шаре?{E108:0018}
Бессмыслица какая-то!

entries.en:
Gyark!{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}(I must have picked the wrong thing...)
entries.ru:
Гьярх!{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}(Похоже, я выбрал не то...)

entries.en: This isn't like you, {E108:0010}Mr. Prosecutor!
entries.ru: Это на тебя не похоже, {E108:0010}господин прокурор!

entries.en: Just calm down and think, sir!
entries.ru: Успокойтесь и подумайте, сэр!

entries.en: We're nearly there!
entries.ru: Совсем немного осталось!

entries.en:
You just need to find the right piece of evidence and
show it to him!
entries.ru:
Надо только найти нужную улику
и предъявить ему!

entries.en:
(If something left its mark on the balloon,
maybe it left its mark elsewhere, too.)
entries.ru:
(Если что-то оставило след на шаре,
могло оставить его и не только там.)

entries.en: (I just need to think what it might have been...)
entries.ru: (Остаётся понять, что это было...)

entries.en:
This is it, Mr. Saint!{E108:0020} This right here really is the 
final piece of evidence that will expose your crimes!
entries.ru:
Вот оно, мистер Святов!{E108:0020} Вот она, та самая
последняя улика, что раскроет ваши преступления!

entries.en: When Shaun found the president's body...
entries.ru: Когда Актёркин нашёл тело президента...

entries.en: ...he also found a bouquet of {E108:0008}{E1CB:00E000020000}{E1D5}{E041}lion lilies{E040}.
entries.ru: ...рядом лежал и букет {E108:0008}{E1CB:00E000020000}{E1D5}{E041}львиных лилий{E040}.

entries.en:
Lion lilies.{E108:0018}{E172:002F0001}{E108:0004} {E12F:00070003}Symbol of the connection between parent
and child.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}A popular flower back in Zheng Fa.
entries.ru:
Львиные лилии.{E108:0018}{E172:002F0001}{E108:0004} {E12F:00070003}Знак связи родителя и ребёнка.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}В Чжэн Фа этот цветок в почёте.

entries.en:
THAT's your proof?{E108:0018} {E107:0003}A bunch of flowers that will{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}be rotting at the dump by now?
entries.ru:
ЭТО ваша улика?{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Цветочки, которые сейчас{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}гниют где-то на свалке?

entries.en:
A bunch of flowers that Shaun threw away?{E108:0010} So much{E108:0008}
{E282}for your beautiful symbol of parental connection!
entries.ru:
Букет, который Актёркин сам и выбросил?{E108:0010} Вот вам{E108:0008}
{E282}и прекрасный знак родственной связи!

entries.en: Grr...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D5}{E12F:00190002}That's got nothing to do {E108:0010}{E107:0001}{E1D5}{E1D2}with any of this!

Ignore him, Shaun.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}You threw those flowers away,
that much is true.
entries.ru:
Не слушай его, Актёркин.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Цветы ты и правда
выбросил.

entries.en:
But the bond they represented remains as{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E1D5}strong as it ever was.
entries.ru:
Но связь, которую они означали,{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E1D5}крепка, как и была.

entries.en:
The president held onto them until the last.{E108:0010} An act
which provided us with our {E108:0008}{E107:0003}{E285}final piece of evidence!
entries.ru:
Президент держал их до последнего.{E108:0010} Тем самым
он и дал нам {E108:0008}{E107:0003}{E285}последнюю улику!

entries.en: ...What?{E108:0028} {E107:0003}{E284}{E176:00000000}What are you talking about?

The flowers Shaun disposed of had been squashed
flat.{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D2}{E283}They must have been crushed by the balloon!
entries.ru:
А выброшенные цветы были
сплющены.{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D2}{E283}Их раздавило шаром -- иначе никак!

entries.en:
If we examine the basket for traces of {E041}lion lily pollen{E040},{E108:0008}
{E107:0003}what do you think we might find?
entries.ru:
А если поискать в корзине {E041}пыльцу львиных лилий{E040},{E108:0008}
{E107:0003}что мы там, по-вашему, найдём?

entries.en:
Nonononono!{E108:0018} You don't need to do that!{E108:0010}
You looked over the basket just now!
entries.ru:
Нетнетнетнет!{E108:0018} Не надо этого делать!{E108:0010}
Вы же только что корзину осмотрели!

entries.en:
Anyway, if there was pollen stuck to it, you would
have seen it.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Those flowers are bright yellow!
entries.ru:
Да и будь на ней пыльца, вы бы её
сразу увидели.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Цветы-то ярко-жёлтые!

...Не всякую улику {E108:0010}{E172:000B0001}{E188:00200000}{E1D5}{E1D2}{E12F:00000004}видно невооружённым
глазом, {E108:0018}{E107:0002}мистер Святов.

entries.en: Huh...?
entries.ru: Это как...?

entries.en: Ema!
entries.ru: Эма!

entries.en: Yeah?
entries.ru: Да?

entries.en:
I'd like to call on your scientific skills once again,
if you don't mind.
entries.ru:
Мне снова понадобится ваша наука,
если не возражаете.

entries.en:
Leave it to me!{E108:0020} Alright --{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E12F:00030002}let's take a look at this
balloon basket, shall we?
entries.ru:
Положитесь на меня!{E108:0020} Так --{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E12F:00030002}поглядим-ка на эту
корзину шара, да?

entries.en: Ah!{E108:0020} I've got something!
entries.ru: О!{E108:0020} Кое-что есть!

entries.en: Bright yellow pollen, {E108:0008}{E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}{E107:0001}just like you said!
entries.ru: Ярко-жёлтая пыльца, {E108:0008}{E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}{E107:0001}как вы и говорили!

entries.en:
If it's from the same flowers, {E108:0010}{E107:0001}{E1D5}it shouldn't take more
than another quick test to prove it!
entries.ru:
Те ли это цветы -- {E108:0010}{E107:0001}{E1D5}ещё один быстрый анализ,
и будет точно!

entries.en: Wh-{E108:000C}{E107:0001}{E281}Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat!?
entries.ru: Ч-{E108:000C}{E107:0001}{E281}Чтоооооооооооооооо!?

entries.en: And there we have it...
entries.ru: Вот и доказано...

entries.en:
You murdered the president!{E108:0010}{E172:000C0000}{E108:0001}
{E107:0001}And this murder, you carried out yourself!
entries.ru:
Президента убили вы!{E108:0010}{E172:000C0000}{E108:0001}
{E107:0001}И это убийство вы совершили сами!

entries.en: You crushed the president {E108:0008}{E107:0001}{E188:00360000}{E1DA}with that balloon!
entries.ru: Вы раздавили президента {E108:0008}{E107:0001}{E188:00360000}{E1DA}этим шаром!

entries.en:
Then you loaded his body into the basket,
and took him to the refrigeration unit!
entries.ru:
Затем погрузили тело в корзину
и свезли в холодильную камеру!

entries.en:
But why?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D5}{E12F:00070001}Why go to the trouble of removing
the body?
entries.ru:
Но зачем?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D5}{E12F:00070001}Зачем было возиться
и вывозить тело?

entries.en:
Because he knew {E108:0010}{E107:0003}another incident was scheduled
to occur {E108:0008}{E107:0002}that same evening!
entries.ru:
Потому что он знал: {E108:0010}{E107:0003}в тот же вечер там
должно было {E108:0008}{E107:0002}случиться и другое!

entries.en: Oh!{E108:0020} {E107:0003}Rosie Ringer's murder!
entries.ru: Ой!{E108:0020} {E107:0003}Убийство Рози Рингер!

entries.en:
Exactly.{E108:0010} If he had left the body there, it would
have interfered with his other plans.
entries.ru:
Именно.{E108:0010} Оставь он тело там -- и другой замысел
сорвался бы.

entries.en:
I get it.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}And he couldn't leave the body in the
refrigeration unit for too long either, right?
entries.ru:
Ясно.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}И в холодильной камере тело надолго
тоже не оставишь, верно?

entries.en:
Indeed not.{E108:0010} So, while returning to the Bigg Building to
drop the body off again the following night...
entries.ru:
Никак.{E108:0010} И вот, когда на другую ночь он снова
повёз тело к зданию Бигг...

entries.en:
...he must have observed the fire Shaun caused,
and the Taurusaurus head falling as a result!
entries.ru:
...он и увидел устроенный Актёркиным пожар --
и как от него упала голова Быкозавра!

entries.en:
That's what gave you the idea, wasn't it?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}To frame Shaun for the murder?
entries.ru:
Вот что вас и натолкнуло, верно?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}Свалить убийство на Актёркина.

entries.en: Gnyrrrrrrgh...!
entries.ru: Гнырррргх...!

entries.en:
You made it seem as if the falling head was what
killed him so that my son would take the blame!
entries.ru:
Вы выставили дело так, будто его убила упавшая
голова, -- чтобы вина легла на моего сына!

entries.en: Despicable coward!
entries.ru: Низкий трус!

entries.en:
In order to achieve your aim, you lowered the
president's body from the balloon to the lot below.
entries.ru:
Чтобы этого добиться, вы спустили тело
президента с шара на пустырь.

entries.en: And while he was dangling from the rope you used...
entries.ru: И пока он висел на той верёвке...

entries.en: ...he was caught on Shaun's rehearsal tape!
entries.ru: ...он и попал на запись репетиции Актёркина!

entries.en:
How did you see through it all!?{E108:0020}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}How!?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E280}HOWWWWW!!!

You manipulated people, and you manipulated this
case, {E108:0008}{E107:0003}just as you manipulate animals on the stage.
entries.ru:
Вы вертели людьми, вертели этим делом --{E108:0008}
{E107:0003}точно так же, как вертите зверями на арене.

entries.en: You thought you were all-powerful.
entries.ru: Вы мнили себя всесильным.

entries.en: But {E108:0008}{E107:0003}your reign is at an end.
entries.ru: Но {E108:0008}{E107:0003}царствованию вашему конец.

entries.en:
The animals look like they're mad with you, {E108:0010}Simeon.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}{E188:006E0000}Even Money {E108:0010}{E188:00870000}and Azea...
entries.ru:
Звери на тебя, кажется, сердятся, {E108:0010}Семён.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}{E188:006E0000}Даже Грош {E108:0010}{E188:00870000}и Азия...

entries.en:
They thought you were their friend.{E108:0008} {E107:0003}But you're not.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}They're sad and mad all at the same time...
entries.ru:
Они думали, ты им друг.{E108:0008} {E107:0003}А ты не друг.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Им и грустно, и обидно сразу...

entries.en: St-Stop it!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E280}Stop looking at me {E1D2}{E188:00340000}like that!
entries.ru: П-Прекратите!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E280}Не смотрите на меня {E1D2}{E188:00340000}так!

entries.en:
Heh.{E108:0010} Perhaps they will {E108:0010}{E107:0003}{E284}when you finally stop
clowning around.
entries.ru:
Хе.{E108:0010} Может, и оставят вас -- {E108:0010}{E107:0003}{E284}когда вы наконец
перестанете корчить клоуна.

entries.en:
You're not cut out for comedy.{E12F:0000000C}{E108:0020}{E106}{E101:00000000}
{E1D2}{E1D5}{E12F:0000000D}{E188:00200000}{E176:00000000}{E107:0001}Your tale is destined to end with a whimper!
entries.ru:
Комик из вас никакой.{E12F:0000000C}{E108:0020}{E106}{E101:00000000}
{E1D2}{E1D5}{E12F:0000000D}{E188:00200000}{E176:00000000}{E107:0001}Ваша история кончится не взрывом, а всхлипом!

entries.en: It seems the game is up at last.
entries.ru: Похоже, игра наконец окончена.

entries.en: De Killer!
entries.ru: Де Киллер!

entries.en:
Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
May I be the first to congratulate you.
entries.ru:
Мистер Эджворт.{E108:0010}
Позвольте мне первым вас поздравить.

entries.en:
You have unmasked {E041}the person behind this{E040}
entire sorry affair.
entries.ru:
Вы сорвали маску с {E041}кукловода{E040},
стоявшего за всем этим скверным делом.
Теперь {E108:0010}{E107:0003}{E1D1}я могу спокойно...

entries.en: No!
entries.ru: Нет!

entries.en: Guns are so clumsy, {E108:0010}don't you find?
entries.ru: Огнестрельное так неуклюже, {E108:0010}не находите?

entries.en: I...{E108:0018} {E1D1}I don't have a gun...
entries.ru: У-У меня...{E108:0018} {E1D1}У меня нет оружия...

entries.en:
Please.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Not only are you carrying one, you were
just about to draw it.
entries.ru:
Помилуйте.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Оно при вас, и вы как раз
собирались его достать.

entries.en:
(He must have stolen it from the president after
murdering him...!)
entries.ru:
(Должно быть, забрал у президента,
когда убил его...!)

entries.en: This gentleman betrayed a bond of trust.
entries.ru: Этот господин предал наше с ним доверие.

entries.en:
He knew the so-called president was an impostor,{E108:0008}
{E188:00310000}{E1D1}and yet he employed me to kill him nonetheless.
entries.ru:
Он знал, что «президент» -- подставной,{E108:0008}
{E188:00310000}{E1D1}и всё же поручил мне его убить.

entries.en:
There is nothing more dangerous for an assassin than
to be lied to about the nature of one's target.
entries.ru:
Для убийцы нет ничего опаснее, чем ложь
о том, кто перед ним цель.

entries.en:
If one does not know what cards one's opponent is
holding, {E108:0008}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}one can be very unpleasantly surprised.
entries.ru:
Не зная, что у противника на руках,{E108:0008}
{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}можно очень неприятно удивиться.

entries.en: Mggggrrgh!
entries.ru: Мгггрргх!

entries.en: But that was {E108:000C}not your true crime.
entries.ru: Но подлинная ваша вина {E108:000C}не в этом.

entries.en: No.{E108:0010} {E285}Thinking you could deceive me,{E108:0010} manipulate me...
entries.ru:
Нет.{E108:0010} {E285}Вы решили, что можете меня обмануть,{E108:0010}
использовать...

entries.en: That is the crime for which you are about to pay...
entries.ru: Вот за это вам и придётся заплатить...

entries.en: NO!
entries.ru: НЕТ!

entries.en: Y-You...!
It's been a while, {E108:0010}de Killer.
entries.ru: Давно же не виделись, {E108:0010}де Киллер.

entries.en: Step aside, Kanis.{E108:0010} That man is {E108:0008}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}my target.
entries.ru: Посторонитесь, Канис.{E108:0010} Этот человек -- {E108:0008}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}моя цель.

entries.en:
I would politely ask that you call off this
particular job.
entries.ru:
Я бы учтиво просил вас отказаться
именно от этого заказа.

entries.en:
He'll pay for his crimes.{E108:0010} {E1D5}But in prison, not at
the end of your blade.
entries.ru:
За своё он ответит.{E108:0010} {E1D5}Но в тюрьме, а не на
конце вашего клинка.

entries.en: And if I refuse?
entries.ru: А если я откажусь?

entries.en:
Let us just say that I might not take the loss of the{E108:0010}
{E188:00730000}{E1D1}one life that I ever saved too well.
entries.ru:
Скажем так: единственную жизнь, что я спас,{E108:0010}
{E188:00730000}{E1D1}я так просто отнять не дам.

entries.en:
You?{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}Save a life?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}Bodhidharma Kanis --{E108:0008} {E283}the Blind Butcher himself?
entries.ru:
Вы?{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}Спасли жизнь?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}Бодхидхарма Канис --{E108:0008} {E283}сам Слепой Мясник?

entries.en: Keh heh heh!{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Preposterous, I know.
entries.ru: Кхех-хех-хех!{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Смехотворно, право.

entries.en:
But yes.{E108:0010} I, who have taken so many lives, once{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}chose to preserve one.{E108:0018} That of an innocent young pup.
entries.ru:
И всё же.{E108:0010} Я, отнявший столько жизней, однажды{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}одну сберёг.{E108:0018} Жизнь невинного щенка.

entries.en:
And he, in his turn, saved mine.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Something of a bond formed between us.
entries.ru:
А он, в свой черёд, сберёг мою.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Так между нами и возникла связь.

entries.en: Laugh all you like.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I know I would.
entries.ru: Смейтесь сколько угодно.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Я бы смеялся.

entries.en:
But...{E108:0014} {E107:0002}{E188:00730000}{E1D1} I would respectfully request that you
spare him.
entries.ru:
Но...{E108:0014} {E107:0002}{E188:00730000}{E1D1}я почтительно прошу вас его
пощадить.

entries.en:
As one professional to another...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}I ask that you let this particular target live.
entries.ru:
Как собрат по ремеслу...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}прошу: оставьте эту цель в живых.

entries.en:
...Very well.{E108:0010}
The boy must mean a lot to you.
entries.ru:
...Что ж, хорошо.{E108:0010}
Мальчик, видно, вам очень дорог.

entries.en: Thank you.{E108:0010} {E1D1}I am in your debt.
entries.ru: Благодарю.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Я перед вами в долгу.

entries.en: ...You need not thank me.
entries.ru: ...Благодарности не нужно.

entries.en:
I simply see little point in the two of us killing
one another.
entries.ru:
Просто я не вижу выгоды в том, чтобы нам
с вами убивать друг друга.

entries.en: Now, then.{E108:0010} I bid you all good day.
entries.ru: На этом{E108:0010} позвольте откланяться. Всего доброго.

entries.en: No!{E108:0020} Get back here!
entries.ru: Чёрт!{E108:0020} Стоять!

entries.en: You have my thanks, {E108:0010}Mr. Edgeworth.
entries.ru: Спасибо вам, {E108:0010}мистер Эджворт.

entries.en:
This young pup needed to be shown the error
of his ways.
entries.ru:
Этому щенку надо было указать,
где он сбился с пути.

entries.en: And you have done just that.
entries.ru: Это вы и сделали.

entries.en:
.........{E108:0010}{E107:0003}Alright,{E108:0010} I suppose we'd better be getting back.{E108:0010}
Our iron-clad enclosure awaits.
entries.ru:
.........{E108:0010}{E107:0003}Что ж,{E108:0010} пожалуй, нам пора возвращаться.{E108:0010}
Обитель за железной решёткой ждёт.

entries.en: ...You...{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E1D5}killed my dad, didn't you, {E108:0018}old man?
entries.ru: ...Вы...{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E1D5}вы убили моего отца, да, {E108:0018}старик?

entries.en:
...I will not lie.{E108:0010} I did.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}My victims deserve to be
remembered, at the very least.
entries.ru:
...Не стану лгать.{E108:0010} Убил.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Своих мертвецов я
помню -- меньшего они не заслужили.

entries.en:
Keh heh heh.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}Ah, but I sense a great hatred for me
from you, horned pup.{E108:0018} {E107:0004}In that case...
entries.ru:
Кхех-хех-хех.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}А, чую: ты меня крепко
ненавидишь, рогатый щенок.{E108:0018} {E107:0004}В таком случае...

entries.en:
You must not falter, little one.{E108:0018} Here.{E108:0010}
You may use my knife.
entries.ru:
Не робей, дитя.{E108:0018} Вот.{E108:0010}
Возьми мой нож.

entries.en:
Take it...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:0012000A}{E283}and cut my throat!{E108:0030}{E12F:00120002}
{E107:0003}One sure slice is all it takes!
entries.ru:
Бери...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:0012000A}{E283}и перережь мне горло!{E108:0030}{E12F:00120002}
{E107:0003}Хватит одного верного взмаха!

entries.en:
I was growing rather tired of carving my little
statues anyway.{E108:0018} {E1D1}Keh heh heh.
entries.ru:
Мне и без того наскучило резать
статуэтки.{E108:0018} {E1D1}Кхех-хех-хех.

entries.en: Sh-Shaun!{E108:0018} Don't do it!
entries.ru: В-Ваня!{E108:0018} Не надо!

entries.en:
...At least,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I did until just now.{E108:0010} I would have done
anything to make you pay.{E108:0010} No matter how long it took.
entries.ru:
...Хотел{E108:0010} {E107:0002}до этой самой минуты.{E108:0010} Я бы на всё пошёл,
чтоб вы заплатили.{E108:0010} Сколько бы это ни заняло.

entries.en:
Oh, but you should make those who have wronged
you pay.{E108:0018} It'll make you feel so good.{E108:0010} {E107:0004}{E1D1}Trust me.
entries.ru:
О, а надо бы! Пусть платят все, кто тебя
обидел.{E108:0018} Такое облегчение!{E108:0010} {E107:0004}{E1D1}Уж поверь.

entries.en:
...All the pain, all the suffering, it all goes away.{E108:0010}
It drowns it all out.{E108:0008} {E1D1}Numbs it.
entries.ru:
...Вся боль, все муки -- как рукой снимает.{E108:0010}
Всё глохнет.{E108:0008} {E1D1}Немеет.

entries.en:
Maybe it does.{E177:003E0001}{E108:0016} {E107:0002}And listening to you, I thought maybe
that's what I wanted...
entries.ru:
Может, и так.{E177:003E0001}{E108:0016} {E107:0002}Слушал вас -- и подумал, что,
может, этого и хочу...

entries.en: ...Shaun!
entries.ru: ...Актёркин!

entries.en:
But it's not just about me.{E108:0010} Say I get my revenge --{E108:0008}
{E107:0003}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}how does that help anybody else?
entries.ru:
Но дело не только во мне.{E108:0010} Ну отомщу я --{E108:0008}
{E107:0003}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}а другим-то от этого что?

entries.en:
If I become a murderer, my mom suffers ten times
more than I ever would.
entries.ru:
Стану убийцей -- маме будет в десять раз
хуже, чем мне.

entries.en:
And so would all the people I work with.{E108:0010}
They're counting on me.{E108:0008} And they worry about me.
entries.ru:
И всем, с кем я работаю, тоже.{E108:0010}
Они на меня надеются.{E108:0008} И волнуются за меня.

entries.en: Keh heh heh.{E108:0018} {E107:0004}Thoughtful words indeed, {E108:0018}{E107:0002}little one.
entries.ru: Кхех-хех-хех.{E108:0018} {E107:0004}А ведь верно сказано, {E108:0018}{E107:0002}дитя.

entries.en: Yeah?{E108:0010} Well I get it now.
entries.ru: Да?{E108:0010} Ну а я вот понял.

entries.en:
I won't ever forgive you.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}But I shouldn't be the
one who gets to punish you.
entries.ru:
Я вас никогда не прощу.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Но наказывать вас --
не моё дело.

entries.en:
That's what these guys are for.{E108:0020}
{E107:0003}{E12F:00190003}My mom.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}The prosecutor.{E108:0018} People like that.
...Shaun!
entries.ru: ...Ваня!

entries.en:
Wow...{E108:0010} You may be young, Shaun, {E108:0018}{E107:0001}{E280}but you're
way wiser than I'll ever be!
entries.ru:
Ух ты...{E108:0010} Ты хоть и мелкий, Ваня, {E108:0018}{E107:0001}{E280}а мудрее меня
в сто раз!

entries.en:
(You could at least consider trying to better
yourself, Kay...)
entries.ru:
(Тебе бы, Кей, тоже не мешало
над собой поработать...)

entries.en:
Very well.{E108:0020} {E107:0003}{E12F:00120000}Then I suppose we'll be on our way.{E108:0018}
{E107:0004}With me, young pup.
entries.ru:
Стало быть, так.{E108:0020} {E107:0003}{E12F:00120000}Тогда и нам пора.{E108:0018}
{E107:0004}Идём, щенок.

entries.en: O-On our way?{E108:0010} To where?
entries.ru: П-Пора?{E108:0010} Куда?

entries.en:
Where else?{E108:0010} To the prison.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Our home.
entries.ru:
Куда же ещё?{E108:0010} В тюрьму.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}В наш дом.

entries.en:
And with that, {E108:0010}the case came to an end.{E108:0010} A case
that had dragged so many people into its orbit...
entries.ru:
Так {E108:0010}и завершилось это дело.{E108:0010} Дело, которое
затянуло в себя столько людей...

entries.en: But as for me --{E108:0008} there was one last thing I had to do.
entries.ru: Но мне{E108:0008} оставалось сделать ещё одно, последнее.

entries.en:
April 8, 2:54 PM
{E20D}Committee for Prosecutorial Excellence - Chamber
Sorry to keep you waiting, {E108:0018}{E107:0002}{E1D1}Mr. Edgeworth!

What's the big idea, big guy?{E108:0010} Wanna tell us{E108:0008}
{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}what we're doing here?
Mr. Edgeworth.
Your request has been processed and approved.
Huh?{E108:0020} Your what now?
I've asked for my {E041}prosecutor's badge{E040} to be reinstated.
What is the meaning of this!?
...I am returning it.
From this day forth...{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E12F:00000009}{E283}I'm a prosecutor no longer!
I still can't believe you did that for me...

...that to be an attorney is to be a defendant's most
trusted ally.

And that by believing in your client,{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}the {E041}truth{E040} will
make itself known...

That man's image{E108:0008} {E1D5}has been forever burned into
my memory.

As strongly as the vision of my father fighting in the
courtroom...
Good old Gregory...
But that's his and my father's path.
...Mine lies elsewhere.
Mr. Edgeworth...

My path is that of the {E108:0008}{E1D5}{E041}prosecutor{E040}.{E108:0010}
It always was.
...Welp.{E108:0028} {E107:0002}Then I guess that's that.
I'm sorry...

No, {E1D1}no.{E108:0018} I dig it.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:000A0009}And besides, I can tell by that look
in your eye that your mind's made up.
It is.

Alright, then!{E108:0020} Looks like our work together
is diddly-done!

Just don't come crying to old Eddie if you change
your mind.{E108:0010} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}This club's now closed to new members!

Care to tell me why, at least?{E108:0020} {E107:0003}How come you're so
dead-set on popping the old {E041}prosecutor{E040}'s hat back on?
You once asked me something, Fender.

Are you going to keep fighting crime as a prosecutor,{E108:0020}
{E1D1}or help people as an attorney?

Something tells me you've got a big decision ahead of
you.{E108:0010} One only you can answer.

I've been thinking about that question ever since.{E108:001E}
{E107:0004}About how I mean to live my life...

And now that this case is over, I think I finally know
the answer.
I'm going to help people as a prosecutor.
But can't you also do that as an attorney...?

Look at it this way:{E108:0010} Simeon Saint was also a {E041}victim{E040}
of sorts.

He lost his only parent all those years ago.{E108:0010}
And with him, his ability to believe in a just world.
(I know how that feels...)

(To lose somebody so important to you...{E108:0010}
{E1D1}To lose faith in everything...)

(To doubt everything, and be utterly alone...{E108:0010}
To fight and fight and fight...)

All that I can hope to do is get every defendant
declared guilty.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}So I make {E108:0008}{E285}{E107:0003}that my policy.

(But I was lucky.{E108:0010} Somebody was kind enough to
save me from myself...)
Mr. Saint had nobody.

He had no faith in the law.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}He felt that seeking{E108:0008}
{E1D1}revenge himself was the only option.

But I doubt even you imagined that the body double
would ever go so far as to co-opt our country's police.

Nonononono!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I sure didn't!{E108:0010} And as long as Winner
was around, no evidence was ever going to stand!

He even nearly managed to ruin things this morning!{E108:0010}
Laguarde almost got away with it again!
I want to help people like him.
And how do you plan to do that?

If he had been able to rely upon the law,{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D5}{E1D2}none of this would have happened.

Chairman Winner made a mockery of justice, and
in so doing, {E108:0010}{E107:0003}{E1D1}drove Mr. Saint away from seeking it.
The {E041}law{E040} is only as good as its practitioners.

It can be a shield that keeps the people safe from
harm, {E108:0008}{E107:0003}{E1D1}or a sword wielded to wound them.
Just one among many of the {E108:0008}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E041}law's great contradictions{E040}.
You can say that again...

Yup...{E108:0008}{E112:000A} {E107:0002}{E12F:000A0009}It's what we folks in the trade like to call{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}a {E041}legal
contradiction{E040}.
The law is far from perfect.

But one cannot solve such contradictions in{E108:0008}
{E1D5}the law without engaging with it.
I don't think an attorney could have {E108:0010}{E107:0003}saved Mr. Saint.

But a {E041}prosecutor{E040}?{E108:0010} A custodian of the law?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}I think perhaps they could have.

I plan to take up my badge again {E108:0010}{E107:0002}and confront those
contradictions at every turn.
You know {E108:0010}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}it won't be easy breezy though, right?

Fighting the {E041}law{E040} itself?{E108:0010} That's lawyering on
hard mode.
I understand that.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}But somebody has to do it.

...Oh, I don't doubt {E1D1}that.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}And if it has to be anybody,{E108:0010}
{E1D1}it should be you.

Laws are like people, I guess --{E108:0008} {E107:0003}{E1D1}they both gotta
grow and change.{E108:0008} "Adapt or perish", amirite?

You're going to smash this, I just know it.{E176:00020001}
{E107:0002}After all --{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E12F:000A0001}you're Gregory's boy through and through.

And if there's one thing that man did not know how
to do, {E108:0008}{E107:0001}{E1D1}it's give up.

Eyes on the prize and straight on till sunset,{E108:0008}
{E107:0003}{E1D5}that was his motto.
You know what?

I saw that same determination on your face the second
you{E108:0010} mentioned taking up {E041}prosecutoring{E040} again.

You know what's really grown and changed?{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}Hate to be a great big cheeseball, but...{E108:0008} you.

I only wish your dad was here to see it.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}He'd be proud as all get-out.
Fender...{E108:0018} {E12F:0000000E}Thank you.

...Well, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}If you're ready to begin,
we can get the ceremony underway.
Please...

By the power vested in me by the Committee for
Prosecutorial Excellence, I, Verity Gavèlle...

...do hereby, in the sight of the almighty Goddess,{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}reinstate Miles Edgeworth as {E108:0008}{E1CB:000100000000}a servant of the law!
Best news I've heard all week, sir!
Well, {E108:0008}{E1D1}Mr. Prosecutor.{E108:0020} {E12F:000A0000}{E107:0003}I gotta scoot.

Your pops is going to want to know that his kid just{E108:0010}
{E1D1}signed up for the opposition a second time!{E108:0008} Heh!
...Thank you again, Fender.{E108:0010} For everything.

Don't thank me yet.{E108:0008} The next time you see me{E108:0018}
{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}could be across a courtroom.

And this face is a whole lot less roguishly charming{E108:000C}
{E107:0002}{E1D5}when it's not on your side of the aisle!

I would relish the opportunity to face an attorney
trained by my father.{E108:0010} I hope that day comes very soon.
Alrighty!{E108:0010} Fender, out!
Welcome back into the fold, {E108:0018}{E107:0004}{E12F:00080001}Prosecutor Edgeworth.

Thank you, Judge Gavèlle.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}I owe you more than I can say.
You do?

You strove to right the wrongs of the Committee{E108:0008}
{E107:0003}from the inside.
That must have been a {E108:0008}{E1D5}lonely battle indeed.

That's right!{E108:0010} You had the {E108:000C}{E1D5}{E041}Goddess of Justice{E040}
on your side!

Thank you {E108:0008}{E1D5}{E107:0003}for teaching me that it's possible to{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}fight in such a way.

The contradictions within the Committee are like
those within the legal system itself...

If we aren't able to overcome them, {E108:0008}{E1D5}the real
{E041}truth{E040} will forever evade us.

I have you to thank for teaching me that.{E108:0010}
And for setting me on this path.

I hereby swear to confront {E041}the contradictions
that afflict the law{E040}, and to overcome them.

And I thank you for your commitment to that cause.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}As does the almighty {E041}Goddess{E040}.

I truly believe that such efforts are necessary in
order {E108:0008}{E107:0002}for the {E041}law{E040} to grow and improve.

I will look forward to seeing you in the courtroom
again soon.
As will I.

You did not see the best of me {E108:0008}{E107:0003}when last I oversaw
a trial.

The next time will be different.{E108:0010} I will show you what
it means to serve justice with true impartiality.
Judge Gavèlle...
I don't mean to call your motivation into question...
Yes, Mr. Edgeworth?

But...{E108:0008} to my mind, {E108:000C}the {E041}ideal judge{E040} is
not wholly impartial.
The ideal judge is...{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}human.

Even in the courtroom, {E108:000C}they laugh, {E108:000C}they cry,{E108:000C}
they rage, {E108:000C}they smile...

And then, when all is said and done, {E108:0008}{E1D5}they pass
down a judgment based in that very humanity.
I'm not sure exactly how to put this...

...but "perfection" isn't always the loftiest of ideals.{E108:0010}
And it's certainly not the only thing to strive for.
Forgive me.{E108:0010} {E107:0004}This is my opinion.{E108:0010} Nothing more.
You are right, of course.{E108:0010} There are other ways.
...I thank you for sharing your insights.
...Mr. Edgeworth.

There is another reason I was never truly alone
during my long struggle against Chairman Winner.

Someone else was with me --{E108:0008} someone other
than the {E041}Goddess{E040}.
Of course!{E108:0018} Shaun!

This clipping gave me more courage than words
can express.{E108:0010} Simply having it near gave me hope.

No matter how hard things get.{E108:0010}
{E107:0004}No matter how formidable one's opponent.

When we feel that we are not alone, we can keep
going, no matter how hard the road ahead.

Mistakes have been made.{E108:0010} But we must fix them.{E108:0020}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}For Shaun's sake more than anyone's.

(Like the mistakes made in the incident in which
his father died...)

So you see...{E108:0008} {E1D5}there is something more important
even to me than the words of the {E041}Goddess{E040}.

Hah hah.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}Though it may anger {E041}her{E040} to hear me{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}say such things...

Heh.{E108:0010} So that was your secret weapon all along --{E108:0008}
{E1D5}the strength of your bond with your son...

Perhaps you are right.{E108:0010} Perhaps I should not strive for
an unachievable perfection.{E108:0008} {E107:0004}But I must grow.

As a servant of the law {E108:0008}{E107:0004}and as a mother.{E108:0020}
{E107:0003}{E12F:00080001}...That I believe above all else.

I see.{E108:0010} It seems that we both {E108:0008}{E107:0003}have plenty still
to learn.
Indeed.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E1D1}We are neither of us perfect yet.

Let us continue along our chosen paths.{E108:0010} And continue
to grow as we tread them.{E108:0010} {E107:0004}Until we meet again.
I will look forward to that day.

May the {E041}Goddess{E040} watch over you as you embark{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D5}{E1D1}upon the next step of your journey!

What dessert {E108:000C}{E1D1}shall we eeeat?{E108:0018}
